summary.zh: 知名度代表玩家阵营在校园内被多少人听说。它能扩大组织影响力，也会让组织更难完全隐藏。
summary.en: Fame represents how widely the player faction is known on campus. It expands influence but also makes the organization harder to hide completely.

items.zh: 知名度表示组织理念、传闻和存在感在校园中的扩散程度。
items.en: Fame represents how far the organization's ideas, rumors, and presence have spread across campus.

items.zh: 知名度越高，学生越可能听说组织并产生接触意愿。
items.en: Higher fame makes students more likely to know about the organization and consider contact.

items.zh: 知名度不是单纯的支持率，高知名度也可能带来更高关注。
items.en: Fame is not the same as support; high fame can also bring more attention.

items.zh: 宣传和集会等区域行动可以提高知名度。
items.en: Region actions such as propaganda and rallies can increase fame.

items.zh: 某些高调行动可能带来更快的知名度增长。
items.en: Some high-profile actions may increase fame more quickly.

items.zh: 知名度提升后，符合条件的学生可能主动发送加入申请。
items.en: After fame rises, eligible students may voluntarily request to join.

items.zh: 知名度越高，组织越难维持完全地下状态。
items.en: The higher fame becomes, the harder it is to remain fully underground.

items.zh: 如果管理层支持者注意到组织传播，可能提高管理层察觉。
items.en: If faculty supporters notice the spread, faculty awareness may rise.
